pipelineHead.title: Five focused tools.
pipelineHead.lead: From Studio scene building, AI Reup dubbing and Smart Cut splitting to batch Mixer joining and Encode normalisation — every screen hands its output to the next in one click.

pipelineNodes.body: Images (.jpg/.png/.webp) + script + 322 AI voices + continuous Loop FX transitions (Ping-Pong motion across 20-minute scenes).
Download TikTok/Douyin/YouTube/FB videos and run AI Video Reup: Faster-Whisper STT transcription, translation, AI voiceover and subtitle burn-in.
Trim head/tail, extract In/Out ranges, split into equal chunks or auto-split by scene change and silence (1→N).
Join Intro, Main and Outro in order or at random across 1–8 parallel workers via Stream Copy or Unified Mix.
Bring every clip to one upload profile (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4K) with Lab Pin reuse so joined videos never freeze.
